_comment: COPY this file to config/secrets.local.json and fill in your real values. secrets.local.json is gitignored; never commit it. Environment variables win over this file where noted. Only the detection layer (news + insider alerts) needs any of these: the XBRL dataset and the earnings-post content workflow run with no secrets at all.
_telegram_comment: Required for BOTH alerters (they share notifier.py). Create a bot via @BotFather, then message it once and read your chat_id from https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates. Env override: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
_news_comment: Required for the NEWS alerter only. Both have free tiers. Benzinga Basic: https://www.benzinga.com/apis/ . Finnhub: https://finnhub.io/ . Leave a token empty to disable that source (also toggle it in config/news_config.json under sources).
_judge_comment: Required for the NEWS alerter's LLM judge, which decides relevance and materiality. Which key is read depends on config/news_config.json -> judge.provider ('openai' is the current default, model gpt-5.4-mini). Costs roughly $1/month at current volumes. Env override: OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The insider alerter needs neither: it is rule-based and spends zero tokens.
